located_observations.location: upper-left to upper edge and both sides
located_observations.observation: Overhead adult shoulders, seated bodies and bowls make a broad connected painted enclosure; cropped food bowl at upper left and drum at lower right occupy substantial contour segments.

located_observations.location: upper-left rice dish and lower-right percussion
located_observations.observation: Rice, fresh greens and a drum are recognizable; photographic food and drum textures interrupt broad painted shapes along curved object edges, without small rectangular photograph cards.

Central title is the first textual anchor. The nearby date/time above lead to right venue/entry, then lower-right cost/participation. The open bottom-left channel contains the cup reminder and lingering invitation. All eleven entries can be read.
The large title and two diagonal pictorial masses are immediate anchors; adults visibly surround the same communal opening. Practical lines become small at this thumbnail size.
Title has a serif construction with consistent syllable proportions; practical groups have open counters, even strokes and visible word gaps. No malformed Hangul or clipped line ends identified.

located_observations.location: upper-left reaching arm, cup holders and lower-right drummer
located_observations.observation: Painted reaching arm joins its celadon sleeve, cup holders have hands around their cups, and the drummer has two hands resting on the same lap drum. Cropped figure edges limit full body inspection but no obvious detached hand or unsupported drum is visible.
Broad paint edges remain intentional; photo dish/drum edges are curved and clear. Text stays on pale quiet regions away from photographic noise and brush ridges.

The pictorial enclosure occupies the upper and side structure and the inward bends determine separate copy locations. It is a populated nonliteral montage rather than an empty rendered wall/floor/room holding a rectangular title-and-footer package. Photographic incursions are substantial image masses, not subordinate small pictures.

style.requirement: Assigned overhead painted gathering with substantial clean photographic incursions, an irregular central invitation and distributed horizontal information.
style.observations: Adults and shared food/percussion form the enclosure; two large photographic crops replace contour segments; hospitable serif identity and quiet dark practical groups follow the inner bounds.
style.plan_variations: Identity is larger than the advisory plan, lower-left invitation is further inward, and English/descriptor use serif forms. These do not break client conditions or use-size reading.

ratio.rounding_policy: Nearest-integer native rounding of one edge with <=0.5 pixel deviation permitted.

flat_opaque_single_poster.observations: One rectangular opaque artwork, no room mockup, contact sheet, frame or comparison panel.

substantive_nonglyph.observations: Large shared dish, seated adult bodies, cups and lap percussion connect food, music and company in the same overhead gathering.

adult_neighborhood_event.observations: Anonymous adult seated neighbors share dishes and listen around percussion; no real business or identifiable performer promotion.

usage720_readability.observations: All schedule, location, access, cost, participation and visit lines readable; no letters cross noisy imagery.

base_template_exclusion.observations: Irregular active pictorial enclosure and large photo cuts organize interior copy bends and the open return, with no passive empty-room plane or subordinate picture cards.

hangul_spacing_and_counters.observations: Consistent readable Hangul with separated words, open counters and no clipped glyphs.

function_and_contact.observations: Food-reaching arm, cup support and two hands on the lap drum are legible at native detail; no obvious structural contact defect.

local_material_finish.observations: Intentional broad painted silhouettes and clean curved photo edges; no visible rectangular paste seams or copy over brush noise.

residuals.observation: Practical copy is small at the 320-pixel thumbnail; its verified use view is the 720-pixel-wide asset.
The time range reads visually as an en dash and middle dots retain their class; raster inspection cannot certify an underlying Unicode code point.
No peer images or independent critics were accessed, so full five-poster diversity and independent quality evaluation remain outside this isolated maker record.

decision.reason: No actual copy, use-size reading, client condition or obvious structural defect identified after the required views and one native display revisit. Advisory plan differences do not justify a repair.
